# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b3 — Contextual help and smarter selectors

**Public beta 3 · opt-in · Home Assistant 2026.10+**

This beta builds on v0.6.0b2 without replacing the **v0.5.1 stable release**.
The original Home Assistant integration domain remains `air_quality_advisor`
to preserve config entries, entity IDs, automations and Announcement Hub routing.

## Improvements

- **ⓘ Help for measurements:** touch- and keyboard-friendly help popovers on
  primary room metrics and derived scientific measurements. They explain
  the physical quantity, common practical implications and potential risks,
  including configured numerical limits **only if a limit exists** for that
  measurement; no fabricated health/exposure threshold.
- **Only usable room-source choices:** the occupied-rooms and sleeping-rooms
  entity selectors require recognizable Home Assistant area IDs or names
  in a state or attribute. If a new source is chosen, the form refreshes to
  offer only its actual usable room-list attributes and **State** when valid.
- **Sleep freshness explanation:** `Maximum room/sleep source age` defaults
  to 240 minutes. It is the maximum time since the source last updated,
  **not a minimum sleeping period**. Old, unknown or ambiguous evidence
  never authorizes an absence-driven physical power OFF.
- **38-language UX refinement:** regenerated configuration translations,
  expanded Greek per-room climate and PID explanations and corrected
  source/state labels.

## Install using HACS

Back up Home Assistant and its `.storage`, then open
[Home Environment Manager in HACS](https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/hacs_repository/?owner=Chreece&repository=HA-Home-Environment-Manager&category=integration).
In its version-selection or Redownload menu enable **Show beta versions**,
choose **v0.6.0b3**, and restart Home Assistant.

If your HACS version cannot select beta tags, use the attached
`HA-Home-Environment-Manager-v0.6.0b3.zip` for **manual installation**
by extracting `custom_components/air_quality_advisor/` into the HA
configuration directory and restarting. HACS installs directly from the
matching GitHub version tag; the manual ZIP is a separate convenience.

To verify, open General settings, choose a sleep-room-list entity, and confirm
that the next form offers recognized State/attribute values. Open the
Lovelace room card and tap ⓘ beside a measurement. For device review use
read-only `home_environment_manager.climate_diagnostics`.

## Beta limitations and hardware safety

No independent HVAC, compressor, humidifier, relay or fan commissioning
is claimed. Experimental device power controls remain separately opt-in,
require manufacturer-specific protection and must be tested on real
equipment. Native thermostat OFF is never automatically undone.
Missing/stale presence evidence does not represent an empty room.
Opening windows remains advisory only.

All software changes must pass Python 3.13/3.14 tests, translation consistency,
frontend tests, Hassfest, HACS and ZIP checks before publication. Latest
stable remains v0.5.1. Please report reproducible defects with redacted
diagnostics at [Issues](https://github.com/Chreece/HA-Home-Environment-Manager/issues).
